description: QD1 Functional Correctness Lane — phat hien bug functional qua probes static + runtime + agent. Chay theo mo hinh Sense → Think → Act → Verify. v2.0-alpha.s6 (2026-05-11): Merge cross-project — canonical P-QD1-stub-todo-aggregate v2.0.0 (thay stub-todo-scan, hop nhat MCV3+EUREKA), +P-QD1-multitenant-isolation-audit (static, deep+) — phat hien multi-tenant data isolation gap. +P-QD1-spec-completeness-check (agent, deep+) — agent probe verify toan bo requirement trong spec co code tuong ung. 10 probes total. v2.0 (S3): chuan hoa schema (lane-status-v1, signal-v2, lane-report-v1) qua _shared/lane/. Fix F9, F10.
